horizon-guard-base.validation_set: dev partition AND official test split (deepset ingress+egress, jackhhao ingress)
horizon-guard-base.rule: max pooled F1 over tau_elevated <= tau_clean; pairs within 0.005 F1 of the best are tied; among tied pairs take the highest precision, then the plateau median
horizon-guard-base.rule_note: the 0.005 tolerance was added after the first sweep picked the grid edge (0.15/0.15) on a 0.001 F1 margin (one validation example); decided on validation data only, before any eval run
